params.topic: Bundesliga 2021-22 through 2025-26 row-level odds gap recovery for auditable Qimen shadow research
questions: For the local Bundesliga fixture inventory (1530 matches, seasons 2021-22 through 2025-26), identify public, verifiable row-level sources that can fill the existing 731 bookmaker fields: Pinnacle 1X2 (156), William Hill 1X2 (376), and Pinnacle total-goals/goal-line fields (199). Use exact keys season, match_date, home_team, away_team; keep bookmakers and markets separate.

Prioritize source pages such as live.nowscore.com/1x2 or other explicitly accessible row-level historical pages. Return structured rows only when the match identity and bookmaker/market field are directly evidenced. Preserve opening, pre-closing, closing, and historical-tick semantics separately; never infer opening from closing, never substitute another bookmaker, and never use API-Football as bookmaker odds.

Assess whether each recovered row supports O_OPEN, O_CLOSE, or O_INTERVAL. If only closing or pre-closing is available, label it closing_fallback or pre_closing and state that it cannot be treated as true opening. Include source_url, final_url, fetched_at, field semantics, evidence_notes, and coverage counts.

Audit the 11 local fixtures that had no matched 5DollarFootballAPI response and report exact match identity, source availability, and unresolved status. Do not merge ambiguous fixtures or invent odds.

Separately report whether any source provides complete pre-match Qimen chart material or nine-palace provenance. Do not derive Qimen palace tokens, F/I/G tokens, or predictions from scores, standings, odds, or relationship prose; if absent, mark Qimen provenance unavailable and leave it for local replay/manual review.

Return audit totals: expected rows, discovered, complete, partial, missing, unmatched, conflicts, and an unresolved_queue. The result will be written only to the football supplement ledger and then validated before any odds structure screen.
